text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, just a few days before Christmas—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I returned to the trainer's office, it had
somehow been completely decorated for Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaaaay!!
Merry Christmas!! Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She got the date wrong for Valentine's too,
so could it be...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Tsk, tsk, tsk!
I've got it down pat this time!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Christmas means the Arima Kinen, right?!
So we gotta celebrate Christmas early this year!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hayahide told me that!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: And so today! I've got a very special present for you, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With those words, what she pulled out was—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Ta-da-da-daaaahhh!
A winter sports encyclopedia!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"A single book packed to the brim with winter sports,
must-have gear, and the hottest spots right now—!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Skiing, snowboarding, snowmobiling!
It's even got biathlons and snowball fights listed!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I flipped through the pages,
I found it densely packed with a ton of information.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It also has tips for beginners, so I really recommend it if you're taking up a new sport!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If someone as knowledgeable about niche sports as her recommends it this much, it must be something truly great.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! I just wanted you to
feel refreshed, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I love sports, so I'm down to hang out anytime~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two of them browsed the feature together
and spent a truly memorable Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Ta-da-da-daaaahhh!
A snowman Christmas cake~~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A snowman-shaped, delightfully adorable yet magnificent
Christmas cake was brought out...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It started snowing last night!
And all this 'inchpiration' just came rushing into me~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"The whipped cream collapsed,
so it was quite a struggle!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Still, after remaking it a few times,
it turned out completely perfect! Ahem!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the Arima Kinen ahead,
you really gave it your all...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You're the one who deserves thanks,
Trainer! Always, thank you soooo much!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's cut it right away—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And with knife in hand,
Winning Ticket stood poised, but—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaahhhh!!
It won't cut!! It's not cutting at aaaallll!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It was just born yesterday, this is way too cruel, waaah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —In the end, after insisting that 'snowmen would rather be eaten,' it took two whole hours to successfully carve it up.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Mr. Snowman...
I wonder if you're happy being eaten...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At any rate,
the cake had just the right amount of sweetness and smoothness, making it delicious—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It hurshtsh shooo baaaad~~~~~!!!
Mr. Shnowmaaaaan!!!!!'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Together with Winning Ticket,
I spent a truly memorable Christmas!
